task: MP-DROP-0: 液滴入水小规模证伪先导——LBM vs SPH 同题关键结果一致性

issues: Interface diffusion too strong at low resolution
Droplet merges with pool by t*~0.8
Cannot track distinct droplet after merging
Free-surface clamping may affect splashing dynamics

Re.note: Re mismatch due to LBM viscosity constraints

penetration_depth.note: LBM values are pool surface oscillations, not droplet penetration

shape_ratio.note: LBM shape ratio reflects pool surface deformation, not droplet shape

description.lbm: Droplet diffuses into pool within t*~0.8, no distinct droplet structure after. Pool surface shows oscillations.
description.sph: Droplet maintains integrity until t*~1.5, then breaks into thin sheet. Proper entry cavity and splash formation.

attribution.mechanism: Interface diffusion too strong at low resolution (16 cells droplet diameter). CG model requires >=32 cells/diameter for stable interface (Latva-Kokko & Rothman 2005).
evidence: Phase field phi shows no distinct droplet after merging
secondary_causes: Resolution mismatch: LBM 16 cells vs SPH 32 particles across droplet diameter
Physical model difference: CG two-component vs SPH single-fluid free-surface
literature: Latva-Kokko, J., & Rothman, D. H. (2005). Diffusion parameters of the color-gradient lattice Boltzmann method. Journal of Statistical Physics, 118(3-4), 535-554.
Gunstensen, T. G., et al. (2019). A review of the lattice Boltzmann methods for two-phase flows. Archives of Computational Methods in Engineering, 1-30.

recommendation.reason: Failure attributed to known LBM CG model limitation at low resolution, not a solver bug. Physical models are fundamentally different (CG two-component vs SPH free-surface).
next_steps: Replace LBM CG model with Shan-Chen pseudo-potential model (explicit surface tension control)
Increase LBM resolution to 256x512 or higher (droplet >= 32 cells diameter)
Match Re numbers by adjusting viscosity (current mismatch: factor of 33)
Consider dual-fluid SPH for better comparison with LBM CG
Redesign comparison with matched physical models and resolution

summary.headline: FAIL: LBM CG droplet diffuses into pool, SPH droplet maintains integrity
key_findings: LBM CG model: droplet merges with pool by t*~0.8 due to interface diffusion
SPH WCSPH: droplet maintains integrity until t*~1.5, proper entry dynamics
Penetration depth relative error: 85-98% (all fail 25% criterion)
Shape ratio relative error: 24-91% (2 of 3 fail 25% criterion)
summary.root_cause: LBM Color-Gradient model requires higher resolution (>=32 cells/diameter) for stable interface. At 16 cells/diameter, interface diffusion causes premature droplet-pool merging.
summary.conclusion: This is a known limitation of the CG model, not a solver bug. For droplet entry problems, use Shan-Chen model or increase resolution significantly.
